# Get-DiskUsageAudit

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Finds the largest files and duplicate files under a local or UNC path (audit only).

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/windows/server/Get-DiskUsageAudit.ps1` |
| Platform | Windows (PowerShell 5.1+; 7+ for parallel hashing) |
| Permissions | Read access to the scanned path (local administrator to see all system folders) |
| Safety | Read-only |

## When to use

A volume is filling up and you need to see what is taking space, or to find duplicate data before a migration.

## Description

Scans a folder tree and reports:
  - the N largest files
  - duplicate files, detected by Name, Name+Size, or SHA256 hash (hash mode groups by size first, and hashes in
    parallel on PowerShell 7+)

Both results are exported to CSV. This script never deletes, moves, or modifies the files it scans.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-ScanPath` | String | No | Folder to scan: a drive root, folder, or UNC path. Default is the system drive root. |
| `-Mode` | String | No | What to report: Largest, Duplicates, or Both (default). |
| `-MinFileSizeKB` | Int32 | No | Ignore files smaller than this. Default 1. |
| `-SkipExtension` | String[] | No | File extensions to ignore. Default .iso, .zip, .log |
| `-TopLargestCount` | Int32 | No | How many largest files to report. Default 25. |
| `-DuplicateMode` | String | No | Name, NameSize (default) or Hash. Hash is the most accurate and the slowest. |
| `-ParallelThrottle` | Int32 | No | Concurrent hashing threads (PowerShell 7+ only). Default 8. |
| `-OutputPath` | String | No | Folder for CSV reports. Falls back to $env:TOOLBOX_REPORT_DIR, then prompts. |
| `-CustomerName` | String | No | Optional. Adds a &lt;OutputPath&gt;\&lt;CustomerName&gt; subfolder. |

## Examples

```powershell
.\Get-DiskUsageAudit.ps1 -ScanPath D:\ -Mode Largest -OutputPath D:\Reports
```

```powershell
.\Get-DiskUsageAudit.ps1 -ScanPath \\fileserver\shares -Mode Duplicates -DuplicateMode Hash -OutputPath D:\Reports -CustomerName Contoso
```
